change: Enable the existing staggered row stride for BF16 wide full-y reduction partials: AlignUp(tileCount, 16) + 8 FP32 elements. The existing chooser uses the selected stride in both row-budget calculations and allocation; InitBuffer order, active views, retained-y pitch, arithmetic, and synchronization are unchanged.
hypothesis: BF16 reduction rows previously used a fixed 16-float stride, so each row began at the same 64B-relative phase. The selected stride shifts successive row starts by 32B modulo 64B while retaining contiguous tile partials. R008 used this stride rule for FP16; R173 extends it to the BF16 path, whose reduction partial accesses share the pass-1 lifetime with conversion scratch. No bank mapping or performance gain is assumed.
